subject.title: feat: trace Claude Code CLI model calls

question: Should the public `model.call.*` contract expand from one observable provider request to a union of provider requests and opaque CLI turns?
rationale: The discriminator makes the difference machine-readable, but deciding whether existing event and metric consumers must adopt that distinction is a public telemetry compatibility choice rather than a mechanical implementation detail.

options.title: Keep Request Scope
options.body: Reserve `model.call.*` and GenAI inference spans for observable provider requests, and represent Claude CLI or Codex aggregate turns through harness/run or a distinct turn operation.

options.title: Adopt Union Contract
options.body: Approve request and turn observation units in one public family, with explicit migration guidance and compatibility tests for existing diagnostic consumers and dashboards.

recommendation.title: Keep Request Scope
recommendation.body: Reserve `model.call.*` and GenAI inference spans for observable provider requests, and represent Claude CLI or Codex aggregate turns through harness/run or a distinct turn operation.

likelyOwner.reason: The observability diagnostics, model-call lifecycle, metrics, and documentation history makes this person the strongest available owner for the public operation boundary.
